source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
In the opposing player's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), when an attack targets a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours up to 6" from this model, this model may use this ability. Then, when the attacking unit has made all its attacks, the targeted **DEATH GUARD** unit may shoot as though in your own Shooting phase, but:

- each of its attacks has its **BS** characteristic worsened by 1
- it can target only the attacking unit, provided that unit is eligible to be targeted

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
